graph.name: 4. Give a specialist model a different job
graph.description:
Give an auxiliary Model Call its own system Instructions and pass its result into native Guidance.

Open this independent unified workflow document and enable Lattice before Send. Ordinary generation uses Active SillyTavern.
Set SceneDesigner to Active SillyTavern or choose a different configured local auxiliary model.

Open Give a specialist model a different job and inspect the named pins.
Inspect Model Call.instructions: this is the auxiliary system message.
Change the auxiliary binding independently of ordinary native generation.
Send in a disposable story, inspect checkpoints, then explicitly Apply or Reject. Preview never publishes or settles proposals.

Calls: 1 auxiliary Model Call request; one ordinary native generation; no retries.
Checkpoints:
Model Call · separate job.out: A specialist suggestion becomes material for Compose Guidance.

request.title: Text
request.text: Suggest a single environmental complication for the current scene. Keep it reversible.

specialist.title: Model Call
specialist.instructions: You are a concise scene designer. Return one practical complication, preserve player agency, and never write the finished reply.
